agentGuide:
Base path /v3. Account: GET /account. Contacts: GET /contacts?limit=20; one: GET /contacts/; create or update: POST /contacts {"email": "...", "attributes": {"PRENOM": "..."}, "listIds": [2], "updateEnabled": true}; lists: GET /contacts/lists. Transactional mail: POST /smtp/email {"sender": {"email": "...", "name": "..."}, "to": [{"email": "..."}], "subject": "...", "htmlContent": "

...

"} (or templateId and params); its events: GET /smtp/statistics/events?email=. Campaigns: GET /emailCampaigns?status=sent, one: GET /emailCampaigns/, report inside statistics; create: POST /emailCampaigns; send now: POST /emailCampaigns//sendNow — asks for confirmation. SMS: POST /transactionalSMS/sms. Senders: GET /senders. The key is set by Allkin.
